build: pipeline test with FIXTURE SDK (not the real SDK)

results.name: Build succeeds for all 12 pages from a manifest-verified fixture
results.actual:
exit 0 izard _ GaonGreen.html        (no external code)  inline-script hashes=5
built 12 pages -> ../../../tmp/claude-0/pinned-VUYBxS/out  (sdk 0.0.0-FIXTURE FIXTURE)

results.name: No page references external script/import code, no CDN host, no floating @2 SDK

results.expected: 10 SDK pages, all with matching SRI

results.name: CSP: script-src has no unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval, only self + sha256 hashes; connect-src is self + the one Supabase host
